C01: Chat targets are workspace-scoped, unique per kind and URL, reject credentialed URLs and never return stored credentials from listings.
C02: Placements report current/behind against the card head, edited/missing from scans; failed scans keep known copies; removing a target removes its placements.
C03: Exported copies resolve to library revisions by lineage revision hash first, then content hash, within the workspace only.
C04: Archive reference placements retain exact external versions and bounded identity receipts without owned cards or revisions; scans, forgetting, unlinking and target removal remain workspace scoped.
C05: Trusted inbound receipts are unique per workspace and commit atomically with an actual authored source fork; competing duplicate forks roll back and later saves retain private provenance without uniqueness collisions.
C06: Upgrading populated schema13 preserves duplicate arbitrary local receipt-like JSON unchanged and never interprets authored documents as trusted import receipts.
